guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 串聯灌溉調蓄與土石壩滲排水。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Serial irrigation storage and embankment drainage. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 現行官方列出曾文壩高 134 m、壩頂長 400 m
1973 年公開紀錄：曾文水庫工程於十月三十一日完成
教學假設：串聯水庫的內部轉水；Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day
教學假設：壩體孔壓與有效應力；sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa
教學假設：排水層的導水阻力；Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m
教學假設：假想閘下出流量；Cd=0.65; b=4 m; opening=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; H=9 m; Q=Cd b opening sqrt(2gH)=27.63975 m3/s
factsEn: The current authority lists Tsengwen height 134 m and crest length 400 m
1973 documented event: Tsengwen reservoir construction is completed on 31 October

Teaching assumption, Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day
Teaching assumption, Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa
Teaching assumption, Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer: Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m
Teaching assumption, Hypothetical gated underflow: Cd=0.65; b=4 m; opening=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; H=9 m; Q=Cd b opening sqrt(2gH)=27.63975 m3/s
timeline: 1973　曾文水庫工程於十月三十一日完成
2014　美國墾務局設計標準索引列出滲流章一月版本，屬方法資料年代
2026　本教材核對公開資料並獨立重算假想示例，不是新增工程完工紀錄
timelineEn: 1973 — Tsengwen reservoir construction is completed on 31 October
2014 — The Reclamation standards index lists the January seepage chapter; this dates a methodological reference
2026 — The curriculum checks public evidence and independently recalculates hypothetical examples; this is not a new project completion
codes: 美國墾務局設計標準十三：土石壩
美國墾務局設計標準十四：水壩附屬構造物
codesEn: Reclamation Design Standards No. 13: Embankment Dams
Reclamation Design Standards No. 14: Appurtenant Structures for Dams
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：曾文水庫大壩
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Tsengwen Dam
guides.concept: 曾文案例將土石壩內的有效應力及排水，連到下游串聯水庫、灌溉渠道與水能利用。學生把閘門出流、消能功率與泥砂質量分開記帳，再核對渠道容量、田間需水及壩頂沉陷趨勢。全課以假想資料檢驗物理關係，避免把容量相加當成可以任意調度的同一水池。
guides.conceptEn: The Tsengwen case links effective stress and drainage inside an embankment to downstream serial storage, irrigation canals and energy recovery. Learners keep gate discharge, dissipated power and sediment mass in separate accounts before checking canal capacity, field demand and settlement trends. Hypothetical data test physical relationships without treating two reservoir capacities as one freely interchangeable pool.
procedure: 曾文與烏山頭的串聯背景提醒水量帳必須選好邊界：對上游水庫而言轉送是流出，對下游是流入，但對合併系統而言它只是內部交換。分池蓄量仍很重要，因為下游需求不能無視輸水能力與旅行時間。兩池總量增加不代表每池都增加，更不表示水可以立即任意調往任何位置。
土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。以總應力減孔壓可說明排水與蓄水變化如何影響骨架受力，但這是單點應力關係，不直接等於整體抗滑能力。若土未飽和或有明顯各向異性，還需要更適當的有效應力描述與材料參數，不能把飽和模型無條件外推。
下游排水層提供較低阻力通路，讓穿過心層的水離開並降低孔壓。達西式可由流量反推所需水頭損失，顯示濾料堵塞或有效面積縮小會提高上游水頭。導水良好與保土功能是兩個要求，材料粗化雖能降低阻力，卻不一定維持對細料的截留，不能只追求最大流量。
閘下出流把上游水頭轉成高速水流，開口面積與局部收縮共同控制通量。用孔口形式可作量級比較，但真實閘門出流還要分自由與淹沒狀態，並知道上游能量與尾水。曾文案例的教學參數完全是假想，不是現地閘門開度表，計算目的是理解水頭平方根與開口面積的一次關係。
溢流水失去的水頭代表機械能轉為紊流、熱與聲等形式，流量乘水頭損失可求耗散功率。把功率除以示意面積得到平均面功率通量，有助比較能量集中程度，但單位不是壓力，不能直接當作混凝土或岩盤承受的力。局部沖刷還取決於流向、脈動、材料與持續時間。
靠近底部的取水可能攜帶較濃泥砂，但輸砂效果應用乾固體質量與放流水量共同衡量，而非只說水看起來很濁。質量濃度本身就是每單位水混合物體積攜帶的固體，乘流量才變成質量率。沉積物是否能被帶到入口，還取決於地形與流場，計算輸出不等於證明整個庫底被清除。
同一股水可以先經發電再用於灌溉，利用位能不等於把水體消耗掉，因此能源與水量可提供不同服務。帳目應把通過機組的水列為同一次放流，避免再加成第二份供水；實際是否可共用仍受渠道高程、時間和取水位置限制。發電效率影響能量轉換，不直接把相同比例水量變成不可用。
開放渠道的平均流速受斷面形狀、濕周、坡度及粗糙阻力共同控制。矩形斷面水力半徑是面積除濕周，不等於水深，尤其窄渠道差異顯著。曼寧式可估算均勻流通水量，但回水、閘門控制或急變流會破壞水面坡與底坡近似相同的條件，需要另作水面線分析。
土石壩壩頂高程隨施工後壓密、材料蠕變、水位及量測基準而改變，兩次高程差除時間只給平均沉陷速率。這個速率不代表未來必然維持直線，也不能單靠向下或向上判斷原因。比較不同測點的空間形狀和時間曲線，通常比單一點的總沉陷量更能辨識差異變形與儀器問題。
灌溉淨需水深度乘田區面積得到作物端水量，除以整體輸配效率才得到水源端毛需求。效率是同一邊界下有用水與取水的比值，若已涵蓋渠道損失，就不能再扣一次。不同作物、降雨及回歸水會改變真正需求，這個固定深度例子只用來練習單位與邊界，不代表實際配水規則。
procedureEn: Serial storage requires explicit boundaries: a transfer leaves the upper reservoir and enters the lower one, but cancels within the combined system. Individual storage still matters because downstream demand is constrained by conveyance capacity and travel time. A rise in combined storage does not imply that both pools rise, nor that water can move instantly and freely to any location where demand occurs.

The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. Subtracting pore pressure illustrates how drainage and reservoir changes affect skeleton loading, but this point relation does not establish whole-slope resistance. Unsaturated conditions or pronounced anisotropy require additional constitutive description and material parameters, so the saturated model cannot be extended indiscriminately to every location or stage of embankment response.

A downstream drain offers a lower-resistance path for seepage and helps limit pore pressure. Rearranging Darcy's relation gives the head loss required to pass a flow, showing why clogging or reduced effective area increases upstream head. Hydraulic capacity and soil retention are separate requirements: coarser material may reduce resistance without retaining fines, so maximizing flow alone does not define a satisfactory filter-drain system.

Gated underflow converts upstream head into high-speed flow, with opening area and contraction controlling discharge. An orifice-style relation supports scale comparison, but actual gates require distinction between free and submerged conditions and knowledge of upstream energy and tailwater. All parameters here are hypothetical rather than a Tsengwen gate schedule; the purpose is to distinguish square-root head dependence from linear dependence on opening area.

Head lost by spill flow represents mechanical energy converted to turbulence, heat and sound. Discharge times head loss gives dissipated power, and dividing by an illustrative area gives mean areal power flux. This compares energy concentration but is not pressure or a structural force. Local scour additionally depends on flow direction, fluctuations, material resistance and duration, so equal mean flux does not imply equal damage.

Withdrawal near the bottom may carry more concentrated sediment, but performance requires both dry-solids mass and released water volume rather than visual darkness. Concentration measures solids per mixture volume, and multiplication by flow gives mass rate. Whether deposits reach the inlet depends on bed geometry and flow, so a calculated export does not demonstrate clearance of the entire reservoir floor or uniform sediment removal.

One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself. The turbine flow therefore remains a single water transfer rather than a second supply allocation. Actual reuse depends on canal elevation, timing and withdrawal location. Conversion efficiency changes electrical output, not the fraction of water physically remaining, so energy and water ledgers must use different units and boundaries.

Mean open-channel velocity depends on geometry, wetted perimeter, slope and roughness. For a rectangular section, hydraulic radius is area divided by wetted perimeter, not simply depth, especially in a narrow canal. Manning's relation estimates uniform-flow capacity, while backwater, gates or rapidly varied flow can invalidate the approximation that energy slope follows bed slope and require a water-surface-profile calculation instead.

Crest elevation can change through consolidation, creep, reservoir cycles and reference movement. Dividing the difference between two surveys by elapsed time gives only an average settlement rate, not a guaranteed future linear trend or a diagnosis from movement direction alone. Spatial patterns across several points and the shape of the time history are often more informative than one accumulated displacement for distinguishing differential deformation from measurement problems.

Net irrigation depth times field area gives water needed at the crop boundary, while division by delivery efficiency gives gross source withdrawal. Efficiency must refer to consistent boundaries; canal losses included in it cannot be deducted again. Crop choice, rainfall and return flows alter real demand, so this fixed-depth exercise teaches units and accounting rather than prescribing allocation or representing a measured seasonal irrigation requirement.
evidence: 將下游需求增加百分之二十，重新求系統與各池蓄量差，再指定內部轉水八十萬立方公尺每天，證明總帳不因轉水名稱而改變。
固定總應力，把孔壓提高五十千帕後重算，再畫總應力、孔壓與有效應力三條示意線，說明若總應力也變動時為何不能只看水壓。
把滲透係數減半並保持流量不變，重算所需水頭差，再把截面也減少四分之一，比較兩種劣化疊加的效果與量測所需證據。
將假想開口高度減半但暫維持中心水頭，求流量變化，再重新加入中心位置改變，說明分步比較有助於分辨面積與水頭兩種效應。
把分配面積加倍求平均通量變化，再畫一半功率集中在十分之一面積的情境，計算局部通量並說明平均值何時可能掩蓋集中作用。
evidenceEn: Increase downstream demand twenty percent and calculate system and individual changes using a transfer of eight hundred thousand cubic metres per day. Show that relabeling internal transfer cannot alter the combined balance.
Hold total stress fixed and raise pore pressure fifty kilopascals, then sketch total, pore and effective stress. Explain why pressure alone is insufficient when total stress changes at the same time.

Halve permeability at fixed flow and recalculate required head difference, then also reduce area by one quarter. Compare the combined effects and identify measurements needed to distinguish the two deterioration mechanisms.

Halve opening height while temporarily holding center head fixed, then account for the changed center elevation. Explain how the two-step comparison separates area effects from the effect of altered hydraulic head.
Double the assumed distribution area and recalculate mean flux, then concentrate half the power in one tenth of the area. Calculate local flux and explain how a mean can hide concentration.
pitfalls: 把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。
出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。
把千瓦每平方公尺誤寫成千帕會混淆能量速率與受力；平均分散範圍即使很大，局部射流仍可能集中撞擊，因此均值低不能排除局部侵蝕熱點。
把機組效率低於一解讀成同樣比例水被消耗，會錯估下游可用水；把發電用水與灌溉用水相加成總需求，又可能對同一串聯放流重複扣帳。
用兩次量測直接外推多年會忽略蠕變速率改變；基準點下沉可能讓壩頂看似上升，若未檢查閉合誤差與外部參考，便可能把量測網變動誤判為壩體回彈。
pitfallsEn: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. Checking only combined storage can hide a lower-pool shortage while water remains upstream but cannot be conveyed quickly enough to meet demand.

Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. Local blockage can redirect flow through bypasses, leaving total drainage similar while changing the internal pore-pressure distribution.

Relabeling kilowatts per square metre as kilopascals confuses energy rate with force. Even a broad mean dissipation area may contain a concentrated jet, so low average flux cannot exclude a local erosion hotspot.

Interpreting efficiency below unity as an equal loss of water misstates downstream availability. Adding generation and irrigation water as separate demands can likewise subtract the same serial release twice.

Extrapolating years from two observations ignores changing creep rate. A settling reference can make the crest appear to rise, so absent network closure and external checks, reference motion may be mistaken for structural rebound.

related.title: 南化水庫大壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「串聯水庫的內部轉水」與「共同放流的發電與灌溉」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；南化水庫大壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Internal transfers in serial reservoirs" and "Energy and irrigation from one release" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Nanhua Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦串聯灌溉調蓄與土石壩滲排水；南化水庫大壩則以越域引水與公共原水供應韌性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on serial irrigation storage and embankment drainage; Nanhua Dam centres on interbasin diversion and resilient raw water supply, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「串聯水庫的內部轉水」與「本地入流與越域供水」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到南化水庫大壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” and “Local inflow and imported supply”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Nanhua Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Catchment storm runoff volume", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 曾文水庫大壩
history.text: 南區水資源分署現行工程資料列出曾文土石壩高度一百三十四公尺、壩頂長四百公尺；歷史頁記載一九七三年十月三十一日完工。教材採此一百三十四公尺值，沒有混用部分舊資料的一百三十三公尺。與烏山頭的串聯功能提供水量分區背景，假想放流與渠道條件不代表運用規則。墾務局滲流章索引日期是文獻年代。南化的比較案例則說明灌溉多目標與公共原水供應問題各有不同限制。
history.textEn: The current southern authority overview lists a 134 m embankment height and 400 m crest length, while its history records completion on 31 October 1973. This course uses 134 m without mixing the 133 m value in some older accounts. Serial use with Wushantou supplies the water-accounting context; assumed releases and canal conditions are not operating rules. The Reclamation seepage date is bibliographic. Comparison with Nanhua highlights distinct constraints in multipurpose irrigation storage and public raw-water supply.
